gate: Decided on V2HO-KF64-s17 and V2HO-HO0GC-s17, each against its own plain evaluation (fused frame numbers come from research_new/fliptta_pipeline.py). PASS if for both models annotated-frame VOC gains >= +0.10 on confirm and >= 0 on tune, and every-frame VOC does not drop by more than 0.20 on confirm.
one_variable: inference only, flip test-time augmentation of frame-level detection only: the frame dumps of the plain and --hflip evaluations are fused by tools/fuse_flip_views.py exactly as in V2HO-FLIPTTA (scores averaged over views, a missing view counting 0; matched boxes score-weighted; IoU 0.55; NMS 0.5). Video mAP is not changed: tubes, linking and snap use the plain evaluation.
purpose: Registered after V2HO-FLIPTTA failed its gate on video metrics while frame mAP rose on both decision models (annotated +0.36 and +0.40, every-frame +0.27 and +0.41 on confirm). Because that observation motivated it, this variant is decided only on held-out models whose TTA numbers do not exist yet. Target: annotated frame VOC 93.21 against YOWOFormer-L 93.35.
test_use: Only on a pass: V2-WS2.0 split-1 test once with the --hflip evaluation fused at frame level; reported as a separate '+ flip TTA (frames)' row next to the single-pass numbers, which stay the headline. Video numbers are the single-pass ones.
